summary: Recursive merge sort of a singly-linked list whose next pointer lives at node offset +4. Counts the nodes by walking the list, returns early for empty/one-node lists, splits the list at the midpoint by clearing the midpoint node's next pointer, recursively sorts both halves, then merges them in order using the data comparator sub_565BB0, and returns the head of the merged list. Structural twin of MergeSortLinkedList (004C6810) per cluster_copy prelabel (DERIVED). Called by sub_566380.

local_names.a1: head pointer of the linked list to sort
local_names.v2: walk cursor over node next pointers
local_names.v6: head of the second half after the split
local_names.v7: head of the merged first half (recursion result)
local_names.v8: head of the merged second half (recursion result)
local_names.v11: head of the final merged list

operations.description: If the list head a1 is null, return it unchanged.
Count the nodes by following the next pointer at offset +4 until a null link is reached.
If fewer than 2 nodes, the list is already sorted; return a1 unchanged.
Advance a cursor to the midpoint node (node count/2 - 1 steps) by following next pointers.
Split the list: capture the midpoint node's next pointer as the second-half head v6, then clear that next pointer to 0 to detach the halves.
Recursively sort the first half starting at a1.
Recursively sort the second half starting at v6.
Merge the two sorted halves: compare node data values with comparator sub_565BB0 and relink the next pointers (+4) to produce one ascending list.
Return the head of the fully merged, sorted list.
